# UMAMI

> Japanese fire-grilled burgers in Sector 8B, Chandigarh. Thick patties
> cooked over live fire on Hokkaido milk buns baked in-house daily.
> A counter kitchen operated by Nimantrit Foods. Opening 1 October 2026.

## Core
- [Menu](https://umamifire.com/menu): All burgers, bombs, fries, wings, drinks and dips
- [Our Story](https://umamifire.com/story): Why the place is named after the fifth taste
- [Visit](https://umamifire.com/visit): Address, hours, directions from Sector 8/9 roundabout, FAQ
- [Order](https://umamifire.com/order): Delivery and collection guidelines
- [Contact](https://umamifire.com/contact): Operations by Nimantrit Foods and press directory

- [Hokkaido Milk Buns](https://umamifire.com/journal/hokkaido-milk-bun-burger): Why tangzhong makes a better burger bun
